mockup.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished high-fidelity desktop web UI screenshot, 1536x1024, for a Chinese cultural community archive website called "Kigurumi 编年志". This is the design reference for a complete existing MkDocs wiki redesign. Contemporary museum collection catalogue meets editorial research library. Palette: almost-white #fafafa, white, ink black #242525, restrained vermilion #bd493c active accents, small deep teal #386d65 secondary accents; NO beige, gold, navy, purple, gradients, rounded floating panels or decorative blobs. Thin grey rules, elegant Chinese serif titles, clean sans-serif small labels. Layout: compact 64px white top header with library/book icon and Kigurumi 编年志 wordmark left; wide fine outlined search field centered; language and sun icons right. 220px light-grey full-height left navigation rail with sections 首页, 编年总览, 年份目录, 近期采集, 地点目录, 人物目录, 来源目录, and small 关于介绍, 参与加入, 贡献与支持, 引用规范, 常见问题, 开源协议 lower down; active 首页 has a pale coral band and thin red left edge. Main workspace spans remaining width with 44px margins, small breadcrumb line. Main hero is a shallow full-width bright photographic field around 360px high, unframed and zero radius, with white studio tabletop and kigurumi craft archival materials: a recognizable animegao female character mask with subtle silver hair and teal eyes on far right, transparent sleeves, a few coral and green fabric swatches. Ample uncluttered nearly-white natural space on left for dark text OVER THE IMAGE, not in a card: small "COMMUNITY CHRONICLE", main title "Kigurumi 编年志" at 46px, 2-line Chinese description about community history, a coral "查看编年" button and understated "参与加入" link. Tiny metadata under text "公开阅读 / 来源可追溯 / 长期修志". BELOW hero in first viewport: section label "馆藏目录" with six compact archive directory items in a 3-column 2-row grid divided by fine hairlines with small line icons and 01-06 index numbers. Labels: 编年总览, 年份目录, 地点目录, 人物目录, 来源目录, 参与加入. Each has one line description and an arrow. Below this show beginning of "为社群留下可查、可信、可延续的共同记忆" editorial section. Keep density professional, restrained, realistic, perfectly aligned, absolutely no invented collection counts, notifications or login features, no browser chrome. This should look like a usable quiet modern archive, not a marketing landing page.

studio.prompt: Photorealistic editorial still-life for the full-width background of a contemporary Kigurumi cultural archive website, landscape 1792x768. Bright soft neutral-white daylight, matte very pale grey tabletop. The LEFT 55% of the frame must be EMPTY almost white #f7f8f8 with subtle natural surface texture and NO objects, entirely suitable for overlaid dark readable text. On the RIGHTMOST 40%: a beautifully made animegao kigurumi character head mask facing slightly toward camera, silver grey bob hairstyle, large detailed teal anime eyes, pale porcelain-like face, subtle blush, resting upright on tabletop, fully visible hair and face, not cut off. To its right few plain light grey archival binders with NO legible text. Bottom right only: dark teal and muted vermilion fabric swatches, slim pencil, a transparent archival sleeve, spool of white sewing thread, light sketch paper. Authentic tactile mask craft materials in crisp focus, realistic studio photography, restrained clean Japanese editorial museum aesthetic, white dominant with black and subtle teal and coral accents. No people, no logos, absolutely no text, no invented event photographs or historical documents, no vignette, no gradient overlay, no dark areas, no brown wood, no beige, no sepia. This is an illustrative themed still life, not a factual historical scene. Composition objects sit entirely in right half leaving wide naturally lit clean negative space on left.
